test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
What would be the word on the opposite side of 'Eat' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f4d0e7053b2438df96799323ca274d40d1da19558a687de943a9b4502281db4.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42cb7de01ca5565a17caf6aad17667726b94199d6036c576a22c6ab4ceccb4e2.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

Eat → Fly

Run → Pray

Play → Cry

Therefore, 'Fly' is the opposite of 'Eat'.

Hence, "Y" is the correct answer.
